headline.text: L3 truffle line enrober centerline variance climbed from 9 to *15* with no operator adjustment by window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L2: No activity in the last 24 hours.
per_plant_summary.L3: Truffle line ran production through 2nd shift with multiple quality and machine issues. Enrober centerline variance escalated from 9 to 15 without resolution. Weight variance and TG4 belt problems were both resolved during the shift. Line completed Level 2 cleaning and declared ready for Monday.

resolved.title: TG4 belt creased causing false blow-off triggers
resolved.summary: TG4C12 belt had crease down one side lifting during rotation, triggering blow-off sensor and rejecting good bars; tech planned replacement but belt was spun to use good side instead.
resolved.resolution: Belt spun to use undamaged side at 16:58, tech adjusted rollers for new direction, preventing replacement cost (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: Truffle weight variance causing low piece count per box
resolved.summary: Individual piece weights drifted high (14.1-14.7g) dropping box count to 236-238 pieces; operator adjusted and stabilized at 253-255 pieces per spec.
resolved.resolution: Operator made adjustments at 17:58, successfully stabilizing weights between 14.1-14.7g and restoring count to 253-255 pieces per box — "line continues to operate properly, with no outstanding deviations" (Lorena Abreu).

resolved.title: Coconut oil tote still solid, not warmed
resolved.summary: Coconut oil remained in block form and unusable; warehouse needed to supply a warmed replacement tote from warm room following FIFO.
resolved.resolution: Warehouse coordinated at 18:20-18:21 to pull warm tote from warm room per IMS direction, following FIFO (Marcos Montano).

resolved.title: Cooling tunnel 1 glycol leak below unit
resolved.summary: Leak detected under tunnel 1 during cleaning; maintenance found loose union pipe fitting as root cause.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance tightened loose union fitting during cleaning window at 06:24; line declared ready for Monday by 07:36 (Kimberly Morales).

needs_attention.title: Enrober centerline variance escalating without adjustment
needs_attention.summary: Enrober centerline difference started at 9 (vs. 3 on 1st shift handoff), climbed to 15 by 16:13; kitchen operator reported no changes made and running as received.
needs_attention.status: Centerline variance at 15 as of 16:13, operator stated running unchanged from shift handoff, no corrective action documented in window.

needs_attention.title: Flavor pump dropped out of auto mode during operation
needs_attention.summary: Flavor pump had been running normally all shift, then kicked itself out of automatic mode at 21:25 immediately after operator check.
needs_attention.status: Auto mode dropout at 21:25, supervisor acknowledged catch was important, no resolution or return to auto mode documented by window close.
